title: Transfection Protocol for Primary Hepatocytes \( Rat Hepatocytes, Mouse Hepatocytes and Human Hepatocytes)   in Targefect Handbook of Transfection Protocols
protocol: Set up cells to be transfected so that they are about 70-80% confluent at the time of the experiment.
Plate out or maintain cells to be transfected in media with 10% serum.
Vortex the Targefect-Hepatocyte reagent and vortex at full speed for 30 seconds twice just before transfection.
Add high glucose DMEM (serum-free) first, then DNA, mix well by flicking the tube about 12 times to create a vortexing action.
Add targefect next, mix well again by flicking the tube.
Add virofect, mix again by flicking the tube 12 times.
Incubate the tubes at 37°C for 20 minutes to form the transfection complexes.
Just before addition, incubate the media completely and add the transfection complexes to the cells.
Swirl the dish to cover cells evenly with the transfection complex.
Incubate at 37°C for 4 hours.
Aspirate the complexes and replace with fresh complete media (with serum).
Assay at 24-48 hours post-transfection.
Use high glucose DMEM as the complexing medium for transfections.
Add DMEM first, then DNA, and mix well by flicking the tube about 12 times.
Add Targefect-Hepatocyte and mix well again.
Wash cells to be transfected with DMEM twice.
Aspirate the second wash completely.
Add 1 ml of the transfection complex per 35 mm dish.
Add 250 μl of transfection complex per well of a 12-well dish.
Add 150 μl of transfection complex per well of a 24-well dish.
Incubate at 37°C for 2-3 hours.
Add 2 ml of complete media with serum (10% serum) for a 6-well dish.
Add 1 ml of complete media with serum (10% serum) for a 12-well or 24-well dish.
Incubate at 37°C in a CO₂ incubator.
Assay cells at 24-48 hours post transfection.
